lines.en: Mia, look at the time. We could have stayed on the beach another hour if we hadn’t rushed for the bus.
lines.pt: Mia, olhe a hora. Poderíamos ter ficado na praia mais uma hora se não tivéssemos corrido para o ônibus.

lines.en: I know. Dinner by the pier would have been nice, too. The fish and chips there are famous, and I’ve never tried them.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Jantar perto do cais também teria sido bom. O peixe com batatas de lá é famoso, e eu nunca provei.

lines.en: Honestly, we could have done so much more. We could have hired bikes and cycled along the coast. The tide was perfect for it.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, poderíamos ter feito muito mais. Poderíamos ter alugado bicicletas e pedalado pela costa. A maré estava perfeita para isso.

lines.en: Oh, don’t remind me. I wanted to rent kayaks, but the line was so long that I gave up. What a waste of a sunny day.
lines.pt: Ah, não me lembre. Eu queria alugar caiaques, mas a fila estava tão longa que desisti. Que desperdício de um dia ensolarado.

lines.en: It wasn’t a waste, though. We ate ice cream, we collected shells, and you only got a little sunburned. Honestly, it was a great day, not a disaster!
lines.pt: Não foi desperdício, porém. Tomamos sorvete, juntamos conchas, e você só se queimou um pouquinho. Sinceramente, foi um ótimo dia, e não um desastre!

lines.en: True. You could have reminded me about the sunscreen, though. My shoulders look like boiled lobsters, and they sting every time I move.
lines.pt: É verdade. Mas você poderia ter me lembrado do protetor solar. Meus ombros parecem lagostas cozidas, e ardem toda vez que me mexo.

lines.en: I did remind you, twice! You said you were fine because it was cloudy. Anyway, I have some aloe in my bag.
lines.pt: Eu lembrei, duas vezes! Você disse que estava bem porque estava nublado. Enfim, tenho aloe vera na minha bolsa.

lines.en: You’re a lifesaver. Do you think we could come back next weekend? If we booked early, we might even see dolphins on a boat tour.
lines.pt: Você é uma salvação. Acha que podemos voltar no próximo fim de semana? Se reservássemos cedo, talvez víssemos golfinhos num passeio de barco.

lines.en: Dolphins? Now you’re talking. I’ll check the schedule tonight, and I’ll reserve two seats on the first morning boat.
lines.pt: Golfinhos? Agora sim. Vou ver os horários hoje à noite e reservar dois lugares no primeiro barco da manhã.

lines.en: Perfect. And this time, let’s not rush.
lines.pt: Perfeito. E desta vez não vamos nos apressar.

lines.en: Deal. Just promise me one thing: no matter what, we’re having that fish and chips by the pier before we leave.
lines.pt: Combinado. Só me prometa uma coisa: aconteça o que acontecer, vamos comer aquele peixe com batatas no cais antes de ir embora.

facts.label: Oportunidades perdidas
facts.sub: O que era possível e não aconteceu: We could have stayed longer. Também serve para It could have been worse. Sempre have + particípio.

facts.label: Poderia ter
facts.sub: Use could have + particípio para uma oportunidade perdida ou uma possibilidade que não se realizou: We could have stayed longer. Quase sempre há um pouco de arrependimento.

facts.label: Should x could
facts.sub: Should have diz o que era certo fazer. Could have diz o que era possível. You should have called (era obrigação) e You could have called (era possível).

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Could have + participle can talk about a missed opportunity.
“We could have stayed” means we stayed.
items.why: It means we did not stay, but it was possible.

items.s: Could have + participle can also say something was possible but did not happen.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Could have + participle can talk about a missed opportunity. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“We could have stayed” means we stayed. → Falso (It means we did not stay, but it was possible.)
Could have + participle can also say something was possible but did n… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A day at the beach near Cardiff · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Sunday afternoon on the coast near Cardiff. Bruno and Luisa are on the last bus back to the city. Their shoes are full of sand. They are happy but thoughtful. There were so many things to do. Now they count what they missed.

“Luisa, look at the time. We could have stayed on the beach another hour if we hadn’t rushed for the bus.” says Bruno. “I know. We could have had dinner by the pier, too. The fish and chips there are famous.” says Luisa. “Honestly, we could have done so much more. We could have hired bikes and cycled along the coast.” says Bruno.
